_doc: Design-correctness rules DB. Per-IC pin ROLE maps + datasheet-derived requirements, plus generic completeness rules. The design_check.py gate runs a board's netlist against this. This is the layer that catches 'buildable but wrong/incomplete' designs that DRC + sims miss. Add one entry per IC; the DB is the durable asset.

RP2040.note: RP2040 has NO internal program memory. Requires external QSPI flash to boot at all.

requires_support.msg: RP2040 has no external QSPI flash — it physically cannot boot or run firmware
No crystal found — RP2040 USB and accurate timing need a 12MHz crystal (internal ROSC is imprecise)

RP2040.min_signal_pins_msg: RP2040 has almost no I/O connected — a working design uses many pins (QSPI x6, USB x2, XIN/XOUT, plus function I/O)

rules.msg: ADS1115 has NO analog input (AIN0-3) connected — nothing to measure
ADS1115 ADDR pin floating — I2C address undefined; strap to GND/VDD/SDA/SCL
ADS1115 VDD has no local decoupling cap
REF3025 has <=1 signal pin connected — its 2.5V output goes nowhere (reference is unused/decorative)
CD74HC4067 COM (mux output) not connected — the mux drives nothing
CD74HC4067 select lines (S0-S3) not driven — channel can never be chosen
CD74HC4067 has no channel inputs connected — nothing to multiplex
CD74HC4067 VCC has no local decoupling
WS2812B DIN not driven — the LED gets no data (dark)
WS2812B VDD has no local decoupling cap (needs ~100nF per LED)
MAX3485 RO/DI not connected to a controller — no data path
MAX3485 A/B differential bus not connected
MAX3485 VCC has no local decoupling

ic_function_min_signal_pins.msg: IC has <2 signal pins connected (only power/ground) — it is not functionally wired

signal_chain.msg: measurement chain broken: the mux output (COM) does not connect to any ADC analog input

connector_required_if_intent.msg: design intent needs an external connector (header/terminal) but no connector part is on the board
